ok this is a long one and I'm genuinely pissed.

some sticker shop called StickerBurrow Co is selling a "Knife Moth Vinyl Decal" for $6.50 (or 3 for $15). that's my switchblade moth from my september 13 flash day sheet. I drew the whole sheet at my kitchen table over three weekends, posted it august 30, and that moth was gone in the first hour. same crack in the blade, same wing pattern. they didn't even flip it. it's a straight scan of my linework.

I messaged them. they replied "love your work!" then "moths are a very common motif" and told me to send a registered copyright through their support form. so, cool.

here's what people don't get about flash. it sells one time, to one person. that's the whole deal. the client paid for that piece and that's the piece they get. nobody gets to print it on vinyl and sell it to a stranger for six bucks. it's not "inspired by." it's my drawing.

and this one hits harder than a sticker would. a client messaged me tonight thinking I was the one selling stickers of her tattoo. I'm not doing that, and I'm not going to pretend it's fine that somebody else is.

small shops don't have lawyer money and these places know it. so here's what I'm asking:

if you've seen the listing, report it. if you were thinking about buying one, don't. the more reports they get, the more it costs them to keep doing this.

thanks for letting me vent lol. back to work.

Hey, I saw your message and I need you to know it wasn't me. I didn't make or sell any stickers of your piece, and I would never do that to you. your tattoo is one of one. that's how I drew it and how I sold it to you. I'm dealing with the shop that's selling the sticker and I'll keep you posted on it. I'm really sorry you had to find out that way. if you see anything else like it, send it to me. and thank you for trusting me with your skin.
